not_found_description: We could not find this page. Go back or check the path below.
error_description: The request failed. A second try usually does it. If the error stays, copy the message below and report the problem.
suggestions_type_selection_description: Automatically create entities from your imported ETS project - from its functional block information, its building functions, or for channels wired like entities you already set up.
suggestions_no_project: No ETS project data available. Import your ETS project file to get entity suggestions.
suggestions_reimport_project: Your ETS project was imported with an older parser version ({version}). Suggestions may be more complete and accurate after uploading the project file again.
suggestions_outdated_parser: Your ETS project was imported with an older parser version ({version}). Re-import the project file to get entity suggestions.
suggestions_no_semantics: The device application programs in this ETS project don't provide functional block information. This information is part of newer KNX application programs.
suggestions_no_supported_blocks: No supported functional blocks found in this ETS project. Found functional blocks: {functional_blocks}
suggestions_no_functions: This ETS project has no functions. Functions are added to the rooms of the building structure in ETS and link the group addresses of e.g. a light or a blind.
suggestions_no_supported_functions: None of the functions in this ETS project could be turned into an entity. Supported are lights, sun protection, heating and sockets whose group addresses can be told apart by their role or datapoint type.
suggestions_no_ui_entities: No entities have been set up here yet. Once a channel of a device is configured, the same configuration is suggested for its other channels and for identically programmed devices.
suggestions_no_similar_channels: No further channels wired like your existing entities were found in this ETS project.
suggestions_provider_fb_description: Entities derived from the functional block information of the device application programs.
suggestions_provider_fn_description: Entities derived from the functions of rooms in the ETS building structure, like lights, sun protection, heating and sockets.
suggestions_provider_cfg_description: The configuration of entities you already set up, applied to channels wired like them.
suggestions_select_all: Select all suggestions of this device
suggestions_select_all_space: Select all suggestions of this room
suggestions_assign_areas: Assign areas from the ETS building structure
suggestions_strip_sort_numbers: Remove sort numbers like "05. " from the names of floors and areas
suggestions_area_error: The entity was created, but could not be assigned to the area {area}: {error}
